title: Artificial Intelligence Safety Measures Act
last_action: Governor approved; enacted as Public Act 104-0538 with an effective date of January 1, 2027.
summary: Requires large frontier developers to maintain and publish frontier-AI safety frameworks, publish transparency reports, assess catastrophic risks, undergo annual independent audits, report critical safety incidents, and protect covered whistleblowers. The Illinois Emergency Management Agency and Office of Homeland Security administer reporting and guidance in consultation with the Attorney General.
committee_dynamics: Illinois enacted a comprehensive frontier-model safety law after bipartisan sponsorship and passage through both chambers. Its framework, audit, incident-reporting, and enforcement provisions make it a core state safety measure.

responsible_agencies: Illinois Emergency Management Agency and Office of Homeland Security

deadlines.requirement: The Artificial Intelligence Safety Measures Act takes effect.

agency_status.agency: Illinois Emergency Management Agency and Office of Homeland Security
agency_status.detail: The law has been enacted but is not yet effective; this record does not identify a published implementation report as of the verification date.

verification_level: Official legislature and public-act text verified.
